title: Day -1 (D-2): Foreword & Foundational Vision
description: Warmup test quiz covering the Foreword by HH Bhakti Charu Swami on the origin, lineage, and purpose of the 64 Community Principles.

questions.question: How many foundational principles did Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura establish for the Gauḍīya Maṭha as a complete blueprint for a spiritual society?
questions.reference: Foreword by HH Bhakti Charu Swami
questions.explanation: Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura founded the Gauḍīya Maṭha on sixty-four principles that outline a complete and perfect foundation for a spiritual society.

questions.question: How many years elapsed between Śrīla Prabhupāda receiving the instruction from Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura and his journey to the West in 1965 to establish ISKCON?
questions.reference: Foreword by HH Bhakti Charu Swami
questions.explanation: In 1965, according to the instructions he received from Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura forty-three years earlier (in 1922), Śrīla Prabhupāda traveled to the West to establish ISKCON.

questions.question: In which publication did HH Bhakti Charu Swami originally translate and publish the 64 principles from Bengali into English?
questions.reference: Foreword by HH Bhakti Charu Swami
questions.explanation: HH Bhakti Charu Swami translated the original guidelines and printed them in 'Spiritual Connections', a magazine published for his disciples and friends.

questions.question: Despite facing a critical state of physical health, HH Bhakti Tirtha Swami continued writing Kṛṣṇa conscious literature to inspire and uplift others.
questions.reference: Foreword by HH Bhakti Charu Swami
questions.explanation: HH Bhakti Charu Swami noted with inspiration that despite his very critical physical health, HH Bhakti Tirtha Swami continued writing to uplift the worldwide devotee community.

questions.question: Who originally compiled the Bengali work 'Śrīla Prabhupāder Vaiśiṣṭha Sampad O Samādhān Sampad', where these sixty-four principles were preserved?
options: His Holiness Bhakti Pramode Purī Mahārāja
questions.explanation: These sixty-four principles were compiled in the Bengali book 'Śrīla Prabhupāder Vaiśiṣṭha Sampad O Samādhān Sampad' by His Holiness Bhāratī Mahārāja.

questions.question: According to HH Bhakti Charu Swami's Foreword, what is identified as the yuga-dharma and the only hope of achieving spiritual success in this age?
questions.reference: Foreword by HH Bhakti Charu Swami
questions.explanation: The Foreword emphasizes: 'This Krishna consciousness movement is the only hope for this world; it is the yuga-dharma, the only means of achieving spiritual success in this age.'

questions.question: Evaluate the relationship between ISKCON's success and Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta's 64 principles:
questions.assertion: The enduring success and spiritual prosperity of ISKCON depend on implementing the sixty-four principles of Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura.
questions.reason: These sacred instructions fully reveal the true essence and framework upon which Śrīla Prabhupāda founded the society.
options: Both Assertion and Reason are true, and Reason is the correct explanation of Assertion
Both Assertion and Reason are true, but Reason is NOT the correct explanation of Assertion
Assertion is true, but Reason is false
Assertion is false, but Reason is true
questions.reference: Foreword by HH Bhakti Charu Swami
questions.explanation: Both statements are direct teachings from the Foreword: remaining loyal to these principles allows the society to epitomize the ideals of the founder and flourish.

questions.question: Match each spiritual personality with their historical contribution to the 64 Principles:
right: Founded Gauḍīya Maṭha on 64 community principles
Traveled to the West in 1965 to embody these principles in ISKCON
Translated the 64 Bengali principles in Spiritual Connections
Compiled Śrīla Prabhupāder Vaiśiṣṭha Sampad O Samādhān Sampad
questions.reference: Foreword by HH Bhakti Charu Swami
questions.explanation: Each personality played an essential linked role across the paramparā in establishing, preserving, translating, and expounding these principles.

questions.question: Examine the following statements about the historical emergence of these principles. Identify the FALSE statement:
options: Śrīla Prabhupāda established ISKCON as the pure embodiment of the principles propounded by his spiritual master.
HH Bhakti Tirtha Swami immediately recognized the value of the principles when reading Spiritual Connections and resolved to write a book on them.
The sixty-four principles were originally composed in Sanskrit by the Six Gosvāmīs at Rādhā-kuṇḍa.
questions.reference: Foreword by HH Bhakti Charu Swami
questions.explanation: Statement 3 is false: The sixty-four principles were formulated in Bengali by Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura for community conduct, not in Sanskrit by the Six Gosvāmīs.

questions.scenario: A regional preaching council is debating whether to focus purely on external institutional expansion or allocate resources to cultivating authentic devotee relationships according to Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta's guidelines.
questions.question: Based on HH Bhakti Charu Swami's Foreword, what principle must guide the council's decision?
options: Prioritize external expansion exclusively, since community dynamics solve themselves automatically over time.
Recognize that organizational success lies in implementing these sacred instructions, which form the true internal framework and health of the society.
Abandon all institutional structures in favor of solitary individual practice.
Postpone addressing community principles until the society has attained complete material self-sufficiency.
questions.reference: Foreword by HH Bhakti Charu Swami
questions.explanation: HH Bhakti Charu Swami states: 'Our success lies in the implementation of these sacred instructions. They fully reveal the true essence and framework of the International Society for Krishna Consciousness.'

questions.question: Identify the author of this personal reflection found in the Foreword:
questions.quote: In order to share these potent instructions with the community of devotees, I translated the original guidelines and printed them in Spiritual Connections, a magazine published for my disciples and friends. Upon coming across the translation, His Holiness Bhakti Tirtha Maharaja immediately recognized their profound value...
questions.reference: Foreword by HH Bhakti Charu Swami
questions.explanation: HH Bhakti Charu Swami explains how his personal magazine translation sparked HH Bhakti Tirtha Swami's deep inspiration to author the book.

questions.question: According to HH Bhakti Charu Swami, what essential quality empowered HH Bhakti Tirtha Swami to expertly guide the world through these sixty-four principles?
options: He had memorized all Sanskrit grammars and lexicons.
He had molded his personal life according to these sixty-four principles, leading by his direct personal example.
He was appointed as the international legal secretary of the society.
He had visited every archaeological pilgrimage site in India.
questions.reference: Foreword by HH Bhakti Charu Swami
questions.explanation: HH Bhakti Charu Swami notes: 'Maharaja has molded his life according to these sixty-four principles... Therefore, he is able to expertly guide the world, not only by elaborating on them, but by leading with his personal example.'
